review_questions: Is a clearly modern retro-styled recreation (Pexels, MART PRODUCTION, 2021) acceptable for a narration beat about 1990s offices, or must this shot be genuine period footage? If a recreation is used, should the video avoid implying it is archival?
Rank 1 and 2 set dressing (wood paneling, mushroom lamp, rotary phone) reads 1970s-80s more than 1990s US corporate. Is that period look acceptable?
Legal risk: accept Pexels' no-warranty position on model releases for identifiable actors (Pexels forbids showing identifiable people in a bad light)?
Legal risk: is the uploader-applied Public Domain Mark on the 1989 Japanese Patent Office film enough to use it, given Internet Archive disclaims rights guarantees? If not, it stays blocked.
